instructions.title: Connect the thermostat to Wi-Fi
instructions.intro: Homey finds thermostats that are already connected to your Wi-Fi network. If yours is not connected yet:
instructions.step_off: Turn the thermostat off with the ⏻ button.
instructions.step_hold: Touch and hold the ▲ button for about 10 seconds, until the Wi-Fi symbol on the display starts blinking fast.
instructions.step_app: In the COMPUTHERM E Series app, tap "Configuration" and connect the thermostat to your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.
instructions.step_done: When the Wi-Fi symbol stays lit, tap Next to search for the thermostat.
instructions.note: The thermostat only supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, and it must be on the same network as Homey.
